beats.say: LISA is now sharing her very first solo EP.
The brand new project from the Thai singer is titled Press Play.
Billboard says Press Play follows the 2025 release of her debut solo full length, Alter Ego.
This solo release arrives just in time for her upcoming Vegas residency.
Billboard reports that her headline Vegas residency kicks off in November.
It is the ultimate soundtrack leading right into her brand new show.
Are you ready for Press Play before her Vegas residency begins?
